wire.generate: POST /api/v1/llm/generate?ai_name=<ai> {chat_uuid, text, model, thinking, plan:false, deep_research, tools:[search,code,shell], files?} -> {stream_url}

failureContract.beforeGenerate: plain HTTP error, no acceptedTurn; safe to fail over (a created chat may be left empty upstream)
failureContract.generateTransport: network error or deadline -> 502/504 syntx_generate_uncertain with acceptedTurn { state: uncertain }
failureContract.generateHttp: 401/403 -> 401 syntx_auth_error; 429 -> 429 syntx_rate_limited (+Retry-After); other 4xx keep status; 5xx keep status with acceptedTurn uncertain
failureContract.afterGenerate: invalid stream_url, stream open failure, SSE error event, truncation, idle, deadline, size -> HTTP error with acceptedTurn { state: accepted }; after streamed output -> finish_reason error chunk; never retried or replayed here
failureContract.quota: only HTTP 429 from generate; the source parses no other quota condition
